title: 远景科技Ricky Jung：AI融资成本上升，中国数据中心需求放缓了吗？
speaker: Ricky Jung

segments.en: Okay, I'm just looking at overall just globally, right? We're starting to see AI financing costs soar, and maybe even some reports of some projects that have been at least paused or pulled out because of that.
segments.zh: 好，我先看全球整体情况，对吧？我们开始看到AI融资成本飙升，甚至有些报道称一些项目因此至少暂停或撤出。

segments.en: What do you see the situation on the ground in China right now? Have you seen a slowdown in any way, and any sort of tightness scrutiny and standards around the sort of financing?
segments.zh: 你看到中国目前实际情况如何？你是否看到任何放缓，以及围绕融资的某种收紧审查和标准？

segments.en: Yeah, I think we can split this into two parts, why it's about slowing down. Actually, we don't really see the kind of slowing down because our off-take agreement is about into lining up to 2029 or even to 2030.
segments.zh: 是的，我想我们可以分两部分来看，为什么说放缓。实际上，我们并没有真正看到那种放缓，因为我们的承购协议大约排到2029年甚至2030年。

segments.en: And this is the kind of agreement is not just oral commitment or something like that. They give you the take or pay agreements, so we should secure the kind of your future agreements, something like this.
segments.zh: 这种协议不只是口头承诺之类的。他们给你照付不议协议，所以我们应该确保你未来的协议，类似这样。

segments.en: So we will still see a very strong growth and strong demands for the China market, and also for those off-takers for the AI demands.
segments.zh: 所以我们仍将看到中国市场非常强劲的增长和强劲需求，以及那些承购方对AI需求的强劲需求。

segments.en: Also, and the reason they have such ambitious and aggressive kind of demands is about like they already seen their business growth by leveraging AI, so they have a lot of confidence by using or leasing the more AI facilities for their business use.
segments.zh: 而且，他们之所以有如此雄心勃勃且激进的需求，是因为他们已经通过利用AI看到了业务增长，所以他们对使用或租赁更多AI设施用于业务非常有信心。

segments.en: And so also for the financial or some of the kind of financial stuff here, we can see that actually once you got a very solid and promising off-take for this agreement, so everybody is well very confident to see that you have a very promising, let's say the cash flow for the future.
segments.zh: 所以，对于融资或一些融资方面的事情，我们可以看到，实际上一旦你有了非常稳固且有前景的承购协议，那么每个人都很有信心看到你未来有非常前景可观的现金流。

segments.en: So all the kind of financial institutions and the investors, they are very happy to give the money or funding those kind of projects.
segments.zh: 所以所有类型的金融机构和市场参与者，他们都非常乐意提供资金或资助这类项目。

segments.en: At what interest rate and cost, though, I think is, and Rick, I mean, what are you seeing? Are our, you know, providers of capital having to demanding higher interest rates to provide that financing?
segments.zh: 不过，以什么利率和成本呢？我想，Rick，我的意思是，你看到了什么？我们的资金提供方是否不得不要求更高的利率来提供融资？
